name: SLHS 5327
title: Introduction to Clinical Topics in Audiology
description: Provides mandated training required prior to any interaction with patients during clinical observations and supports early experiences once clinical practicum has begun. Students will demonstrate understanding and practice of evaluation protocols, professionalism, documentation and interpersonal communication required prior to practicum. May be repeated for credit with a change of topic to a maximum of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
